contact.title: Contact
contact.intro: The fastest way to reach me is by email. I'm happy to hear about projects, collaboration, or just to connect.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.controllerText: The person named in the imprint is responsible for data processing on this website.
privacy.dataText: This website is static and uses no cookies, no tracking and no analytics tools. When the site is accessed, the hosting provider processes technically necessary server logs (including IP address, time, requested resource) that serve secure operation and are not merged with other data.
privacy.contactText: If you contact me by email, your details are processed solely to handle your request. The legal basis is Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR (legitimate interest in responding).
privacy.rightsText: You have the right to information, correction, deletion and restriction of the processing of your personal data, as well as the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority.
